rule.description: Req with NULL or unresolved AccountID
rule.sql: SELECT r.ReqID, 'AccountID = ' || COALESCE(CAST(r.AccountID AS VARCHAR), 'NULL') FROM Req r WHERE r.AccountID IS NULL OR r.AccountID NOT IN (SELECT Account_ID FROM Accounts)
